taskText: Update the project guidance to point users to the existing documentation, clarify the navigation menu’s resource links, and enable type recognition for the UI library’s globally registered elements.
Add placeholder entries for the V3-Admin-Vite Chinese and English documentation and Gitee links to the user menu, keeping the existing project links available.
Fix active-state detection for navigation tabs so the current tab is correctly identified by comparing its path with the current route.
Remove the unnecessary divider from the Chinese documentation menu item so the dropdown styling is consistent.

Update the navigation dropdown with working links to the Chinese documentation and Gitee repository, and remove the placeholder English documentation link. Refresh the package description to highlight the project as free and open source.
Add a route demo that shows how to expose an external link in the navigation, using the link icon and an appropriate title.

Refactor the authentication screen’s form state and validation handling, improve password entry with a visibility toggle, and refresh the verification code and clear the password after failed attempts.

Clarify the handling of unauthorized and forbidden responses: log users out and reload on 401, and show an access-denied message on 403. Also improve the spacing in the unsupported protocol version message.

Refactor the authentication view to use typed form references and validation rules, with clearer reactive state and handlers. Trim whitespace from user inputs and ensure the loading indicator resets after either a successful or failed authentication attempt.
Refactor role selection to use the user store directly and make the supported role values explicit, while preserving the existing admin and editor views.
Allow deployments to choose between hash-based and HTML5 navigation through environment settings, and make the public URL prefix configurable for both navigation and built assets.

Update the fullscreen control to use dedicated icons and reflect the current fullscreen state in both its icon and tooltip. Ensure its change listener is cleaned up when the component is unmounted, and adjust theme styling for the new icon.

Refactor the navigation trail component to use clearer, simpler reactive state and standalone helpers for building entries and handling navigation. Preserve route filtering, redirect behavior, and the existing display rules.
Simplify the navigation controls by replacing the reactive wrapper around sidebar toggling and logout actions with standalone functions, and remove unnecessary error handling from the login redirect.
Refactor the settings panel toggle to bind its vertical position through a computed CSS value, and remove the redundant text alignment styling.
Bind the layout toggles directly to the store’s reactive values and remove the redundant local state and change action. Keep the existing options and behavior intact.

Complete the route metadata type definitions so all supported navigation and display options are recognized by TypeScript, and consolidate the related Vue and asset declarations. Also modernize route type imports and annotations.

Refactor the navigation tab component to use simpler reactive state and standalone handlers while preserving its existing interactions. Simplify the store’s view type and remove redundant title handling.
Preserve query parameters when refreshing a page from its tab, and keep tab state in sync when the route’s query changes.
Preserve query parameters when redirecting to the home page after all views are closed, so the destination retains the original route’s query state.
Update routing so unknown URLs display the 404 page without losing the requested URL, and make the 403 and 404 pages directly accessible as hidden routes.
Remove unnecessary `name` attributes from the 403 and 404 routes while preserving their existing behavior.

Allow route metadata to select either a custom SVG icon or an Element Plus icon for menu entries, with both options supported in the route type definitions and Element Plus icons available throughout the app.
Upgrade the tags view with left and right controls for scrolling through overflowing tags, and refine tag spacing and styling with rounded corners.
Improve the verification-code experience by showing clear loading and unavailable states, preventing stale images while refreshing, and making the code image easier to interact with.
Ensure all consumers share a single reactive theme state, so changing the active theme stays consistent across the application.
Add a deep blue theme option with coordinated application and component colors, and make it available alongside the existing themes.
Add the missing deep blue theme option to the theme selector so users can choose it alongside the existing themes.
Create a reusable global pagination hook with configurable defaults and handlers for page and page-size changes, then update the table view to use it and reload data when pagination changes.
Polish the environment configuration comments for clarity and consistency, and update the table action label from “编辑” to “修改”.

Add a notification control to the navigation bar with a badge showing the combined count of notifications, messages, and to-dos. Provide a popover with separate tabs and a link to view the history for the selected category.
Add a notification panel with separate notification, message, and task content, and render the selected tab’s entries in the panel.

Build out the notification panel so its notification, message, and task tabs display their respective entries with titles, timestamps, descriptions, avatars, and status tags where available. Use a shared typed item shape and provide representative content for each tab.
Show an empty-state indicator when there are no notifications, while continuing to display notification cards when items are available.
Keep the right-panel toggle button fixed to the viewport so it remains accessible while scrolling, and remove the unnecessary font-size and border-radius override.

Display the signed-in person’s name beside their avatar in the navigation bar, and hide the breadcrumb on narrow screens. Populate the displayed name from the account information returned during sign-in.
Add a friendly, persistent welcome notification inviting users to star the project, and include matching support messages in both English and Chinese documentation.
Simplify the navigation’s external resource links and present the role-specific access notices as centered empty states.

Add an option to enter fullscreen for the main content area from the tags bar, while preserving the existing whole-page fullscreen behavior. Show the area fullscreen control only when fullscreen controls are enabled in settings.

Refactor the fullscreen control to support targeting configurable content areas, with customizable open and exit tooltips. Update the layout styling so content-area fullscreen retains the correct background and the control fits cleanly into the tags bar.
Update the tag-view scrolling logic to use the current Element Plus scrollbar API so it can correctly determine the visible scroll area width and scroll reliably.
Add optional grayscale and color-weakness display modes to the layout controls, allowing users to toggle each visual filter independently.

Ensure fullscreen loading is hidden after either successful or failed Promise completion, while preserving the original result or rethrowing the error. Keep synchronous error handling and clarify that the wrapped function is the one to execute.
Improve the wrapper’s generic typing so it preserves the wrapped function’s argument and return types, including its promise behavior.

Add keep-alive caching for routes marked to preserve their state, and manage cached views alongside visited tags. Refreshing or closing tags should clear the appropriate cached views so navigation and tag actions behave consistently.
Refactor theme configuration to define the default theme once and derive its type from that constant. Use the selected theme value directly when applying and persisting changes.

Prevent route-guard loops when account data contains no roles by assigning a harmless default role. Ensure route access behavior follows the dynamic-routing setting rather than relying on a special administrator role.
Adjust the menu styling so it fills the available height while still expanding when its content requires more space.
Enable wheel scrolling in the tags view so vertical mouse-wheel movement navigates the tab strip horizontally, while preventing the wheel event from scrolling the page.
Standardize type-only imports for Vue types, including `PropType`, to keep type imports consistent across the codebase.
Automatically scroll the tags view to bring the current route’s tag into the visible area whenever navigation changes, including when the tag is outside the viewport.

Refactor theme side effects to be tracked reactively with `watchEffect`, keeping the document theme class and persisted theme name in sync whenever the active theme changes. Simplify the theme hook so callers no longer need to initialize the theme explicitly.
Ensure routes configured with `keepAlive: true` remain cached when the TagsView is hidden, while keeping the TagsView out of view.
Wait until the router is ready before mounting the app, so the initial view renders only after routing has finished initializing.
Improve route transitions by using the standard Element Plus fade-in animation for page changes.
Optimize the permission directive’s role validation and lookup, and remove unauthorized elements from the DOM instead of merely hiding them.
Simplify pagination state initialization by merging defaults with the supplied initial values directly, while preserving the existing reactive behavior and change handlers.
Improve theme handling by clarifying the helpers’ roles and ensuring theme changes consistently update the document root class and persisted active theme.
Standardize TypeScript type names by removing the redundant `Type` suffix and the `I` prefix from tag-view types, updating all references while preserving behavior.
Standardize enum naming by renaming the device type enum to follow the project’s enum naming convention, and update its references throughout the layout and store.
Prevent the cache identifiers from being reassigned after initialization while preserving their existing values and behavior.
Simplify the fullscreen loading wrapper by using async/await so it consistently returns a promise and closes the loading indicator after the wrapped function completes, whether it succeeds or throws.
Simplify the badge count calculation while preserving the total number of entries across all lists.
Improve the fullscreen control’s event handling and lifecycle cleanup, and check browser support before locating the target element when toggling fullscreen.

Simplify fullscreen handling and loading behavior while preserving existing functionality. Keep the browser support warning when fullscreen is unavailable, and ensure the loading indicator closes after the wrapped async operation completes or fails.
Simplify the fullscreen change-listener cleanup while preserving the existing behavior of removing the listener only when fullscreen support is enabled.
Simplify the theme selector by passing the theme-setting function directly to the dropdown, removing the redundant wrapper and unused type import.
Simplify role-based route filtering and dynamic route selection while preserving existing access behavior. Keep the route filtering logic clear and avoid unnecessary branching.

Streamline the view-history store by simplifying duplicate detection, removal, and cache handling while preserving query parameters and pinned views. Keep the existing behavior for cached views and affixed entries.

Simplify the store’s login and profile-loading flows by using async/await while preserving token, account, and role updates. Keep a safe default role when the profile has no roles to prevent route-guard loops.
Standardize the cache utility’s naming and update its consumers, while accurately reflecting that the stored theme name may be absent.
Streamline role checks in the global helper and template directive, keeping their behavior aligned and clarifying how each handles missing or unmatched roles.
Improve the application’s scrollbar appearance with consistent styling across the page and main content area, including clear hover and active states.

Optimize the shared request utility by simplifying response handling and improving how default and caller-provided request settings are combined. Avoid sending an empty bearer token when no token is available.

Expand the validation utilities with reusable type checks and format validators for URLs, domains, versions, times, phone numbers, Chinese ID cards, email addresses, MAC addresses, IPv4 addresses, and license plates. Preserve existing behavior while making the validation helpers more consistent and robust.
Update the service response handling to return binary payloads directly for blob and arraybuffer requests, bypassing the usual business-code processing.
Simplify the string validation and make API response handling safer when request metadata is missing, while preserving direct returns for binary responses.
Refine the layout component for readability and consistency by simplifying its reactive class bindings, clarifying the layout sections, and standardizing transition timing.
Improve the layout resize hook’s readability and clarify its responsive behavior. Keep device detection, sidebar handling, route-based layout updates, and resize listener lifecycle behavior intact.
Use the route path as the view key so pages are reused across query-string changes, improving navigation performance in the common case.
Optimize reactive state access in the top navigation by using Pinia’s ref utilities, and clarify the sidebar toggle and logout actions.

Streamline the layout configuration panel by rendering its toggle options from a reactive collection, while preserving their connection to the store. Improve the panel’s spacing and alignment, and add a reusable text-overflow treatment for long option labels.
Improve the tab navigation experience with cleaner state handling and more consistent route, menu, and scrolling behavior. Simplify the component logic and clarify its internal state and actions.
Set the UI component library’s locale to Chinese directly in the provider, and refine the startup notification’s accompanying comment.
Improve the sign-in form’s readability and maintainability by clarifying its form data and validation handling, while preserving the existing authentication flow and user experience.
Optimize layout state access by using Pinia’s `storeToRefs` for settings values, removing redundant computed wrappers while preserving the existing layout behavior.
Resolve the console warning about a non-passive wheel event listener in the tags view. Keep wheel-based scrolling functional while registering the listener as passive.

Extend the screen control to support both content-area enlargement and content-only fullscreen, while preserving the existing page-wide fullscreen mode. Provide clear mode-specific labels and icons, and hide surrounding navigation elements when the content area is enlarged.

Add an optional setting to persist the tag bar’s visited and cached views across sessions. When enabled, restore the saved views on startup and preserve them across logout; when disabled, keep the existing behavior.
Add a reset control to the layout preferences so users can restore the default configuration. Clear the saved layout preferences and reload the page when it is activated.
Prevent circular-reference errors when caching tab data by removing unnecessary route metadata before serializing visited views.
Add a visual layout-mode selector to the configuration panel, letting users choose between left, top, and mixed navigation modes with clear previews of the active choice.
Correct the tab bar’s right-click context menu positioning in the top-layout mode so it appears in the expected location.

Add a top navigation layout option that places the brand, navigation, and page tabs in a fixed header, while adapting menu behavior and sizing for desktop and mobile. Keep the existing layout options working and apply the styling needed for the new arrangement.
Ensure the branding area uses the correct dynamic height in top navigation mode, while retaining the standard header height in other modes.
Polish the in-progress top navigation layout so its header, menu, and content align cleanly across layout styles, with consistent theme colors and no stray scrollbars or edge artifacts.
Enable the top layout mode as a selectable option by removing its “in development” label. Ensure the navigation bar’s sidebar can shrink so its menu adapts to the available width.

Update the startup notices to clarify that the layout-cache reset is for a first-time blank screen, and warn users that the API service may be unstable. Include guidance on following service updates and a link to simulate data for urgent login needs.
Fix search menu scrolling so keyboard navigation keeps the active item visible and mouse hover does not override arrow-key selection.
Optimize the search menu by removing the unnecessary default for the result count and showing a clear error when a search result has no route name, rather than silently ignoring Enter.

Fix menu search for routes without names and routes with required dynamic parameters. Ensure keyboard navigation handles duplicate or missing route names correctly, and provide clear feedback when a route cannot be opened from search.
Fix menu highlighting so an active nested menu only applies the active text color to its own title, not to titles in descendant menus.
Use CSS custom properties directly for menu item height and hover background instead of resolving their values in code, while preserving the existing layout-dependent behavior.
Add a return-to-top control for the page and support scrolling back to the top when the header is fixed.
Prevent blank pages when saved layout preferences contain fewer settings than the application requires. Ensure missing preferences fall back to their defaults while preserving any saved values.
Update menu search so selecting an external-link result opens it in a new tab instead of attempting internal navigation. Clarify that external links do not need a route name.
Update the notification timestamps to reflect the announcements’ current age, moving the Vite launch to one year ago and the original launch to two years ago.
Optimize route-view key binding by using the route provided by the router view slot, preserving path-based view reuse without maintaining a separate computed key.
Improve the loading-hook example to show how to pass arguments to an asynchronous request and display the returned data alongside its success message.
Remove the route-change event listener before the component is destroyed to prevent it from firing during teardown.
Remove the obsolete warning about clearing cached layout settings, and make the fullscreen-loading success message display its returned arguments clearly.
Ensure the current route is added to the navigation history when route-change listening starts, avoiding a separate mount-time update and preventing duplicate entries.

Improve route metadata by adding titles to hidden pages, clarifying the UnoCSS page title, and organizing documentation links under an external-links menu. Remove the duplicate documentation link from the navigation dropdown.

Add a reusable watermark capability for a chosen container, with configurable appearance and sizing, automatic adaptation to container changes, and cleanup when cleared or its owning component is removed. Ensure the overlay resists accidental removal or hiding.Add a reusable watermark feature for a chosen container, with configurable appearance and automatic resizing as the container changes. Clean it up when cleared or when its owning component is removed, and protect the overlay from being hidden or removed.

Improve the watermark composable with clearer configuration options, reliable cleanup, and support for both local and page-wide watermarks. Add an interactive example so developers can create and clear each type.

Improve watermark resilience by monitoring both DOM mutations and element resizing, restoring the watermark if it is removed or hidden, and keeping its dimensions in sync with its container. Lower its stacking order to avoid obscuring other content.
Improve watermark defense performance by debouncing refreshes and mutation handling, and only refresh when the watermark element itself has an attribute change.

Ensure each watermark instance maintains its own DOM and resize observers, so rendering multiple watermarks into the same parent does not prevent later instances from detecting and repairing tampering.
Improve watermark protection performance by reducing the delay before the watermark is restored and handling mutation records more efficiently, while preserving defenses against removal and hiding.

Add an optional defense setting to watermark creation, enabled by default, so callers can disable tamper protection when they prefer lower overhead. Improve observer efficiency by watching only the watermark’s attributes and its parent’s direct child changes, while preserving resize handling and cleanup.Add a defense option to watermark creation, enabled by default, so callers can disable tamper protection to reduce overhead. Optimize change monitoring by observing only the watermark’s attributes and its parent’s direct child changes, while retaining resize handling and proper cleanup.

Improve the watermark hook’s performance and reliability by reusing existing watermark elements, managing mutation and resize observers independently, and safely handling removal when the element is already missing. Ensure observer behavior stays consistent when defense mode is toggled.
Clarify the watermark hook’s comments to explain when mutation observers are enabled or removed, and why removing a watermark that is already missing can happen.

Update global watermarks to use fixed positioning so they remain correctly placed across more viewport and scrolling scenarios, while keeping container-specific watermarks positioned relative to their parent.
Fix the app scrollbar so it fills the available height within the main layout, keeping its content scrollable.
Ensure the header’s bottom shadow remains visible in left-layout mode when the header is no longer fixed. Keep the header positioned above surrounding content in both fixed and non-fixed states.
Improve SCSS performance by replacing reusable mixins with placeholder selectors and extending them where needed, while preserving the existing layout and styling behavior.
Ensure the active menu indicator styling remains intact after applying the shared tip-line style, including for collapsed submenus.
Add a notice explaining that route caching for third-level and deeper routes is disabled by default, and direct developers to the configuration where they can enable it.
Fix top-mode menu width adaptation so the menu collapses correctly when space is limited, while keeping hidden routes out of the rendered menu.

Refactor the Element Plus table example to make its create and update form handling more reusable and type-safe, using the form data itself to distinguish between the two operations. Simplify form reset and table response handling while preserving the existing behavior.
Refactor the search dialog and menu selection to use Vue 3.4’s `defineModel` macro, simplifying two-way binding while preserving existing behavior.
Ensure child routes marked `hidden: true` are excluded from the navigation menu, including when nested under a visible route.
Remove the redundant role-setting method from the store’s public API, keeping role updates handled through the existing role-change flow.
Correct the Chinese spelling of “login” throughout the relevant documentation, comments, and interface text.
Use the shared API response type for the select-fetching hook’s response data, removing its redundant local response shape.
Add an animated character above the sign-in form that covers its eyes when the password field is focused, then returns to its normal pose when focus leaves.
Eliminate the slight icon jitter that occurs when resizing the navigation panel.
Keep the 404 alias while removing the catch-all ErrorPage route, and simplify the redirect route to use a relative path within its parent.

Replace JSON serialization-based deep copies in the table form with lodash-es’s `cloneDeep` to preserve values that JSON cloning cannot handle. Use it consistently when initializing, resetting, and populating the form.

Add a circular reveal animation when users switch themes, originating at the click position and expanding to cover the page. Use the browser’s View Transition API when available, while preserving immediate theme switching in unsupported browsers.
Ensure the header uses a fixed layout whenever the app is not in left-side mode.

Fix content-area fullscreen so it fills the viewport without a top gap and modal dialogs remain visible. Hide the surrounding layout elements while fullscreen is active, and restore the page’s normal layout when fullscreen ends.
Refactor the multi-theme styling so Element Plus and Vxe Table theme variables are managed centrally, and improve dark-blue theme coverage while keeping component styling consistent across themes.
Prevent a blank screen when accessing the development environment from an iPhone browser by registering fullscreen change listeners only when fullscreen support is enabled.
Fix the first cached page so its activation hook fires when the page loads. Ensure route changes are observed early enough and the initial cached view is registered in the correct order.
Fix the tag display order by initializing affix tags before route-change handling and ensuring new visited tags are appended consistently.
Fix the mixed layout mode so the header content stays within the screen bounds and the logo retains its intended width.

Optimize DOM class management by using `classList` APIs instead of overwriting `className`, preserving unrelated classes. Simplify fullscreen state handling and use `classList.toggle` for grey mode and color-weakness settings.
Refactor the tags bar context menu positioning to use viewport coordinates, keeping it correctly placed near the pointer and within the screen bounds regardless of the layout container.
Remove unused example validation helpers from the utility module to reduce dead code while preserving the validators that are still in use.
Update outdated external documentation links across the project to their current URLs, keeping the existing references accurate and consistent.
Fix the navigation menu so all items remain accessible when the available height is limited. Ensure the menu background stays consistent in left-side layout mode.
Remove unnecessary `!important` declarations from layout, navigation, Element Plus, and VXE Table styles while preserving the intended styling behavior.
Prevent long titles in the left navigation menu from overflowing by truncating them with an ellipsis.
Correct the typo in the comment describing when the sidebar is hidden, preserving its intended meaning.
Add a persisted layout preference that can be changed from the settings panel, participates in reset behavior, and is restored with the rest of the layout configuration on reload.
Keep the tab strip synchronized with navigation, preserve affixed tabs, cache only eligible views, and fall back to the most recent valid destination when the active tab is closed.
Let asynchronous select fields surface load failures and retry on demand while preserving the existing loading state, selected value, and option mapping in the demo flow.
